description: The file defines a Wear OS digital watch face service with classes and methods for rendering the watch face, handling configuration, and managing data updates via Google Play services. It includes detailed methods for drawing time, managing modes (ambient, mute), and receiving configuration data.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main class extending CanvasWatchFaceService, responsible for creating the watch face engine.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, handles rendering, configuration, and data communication for the watch face.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes watch face style, paints, formats, and other resources.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the Engine.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles registering/unregistering receivers and managing GoogleApiClient based on visibility.

methods.name: onApplyWindowInsets
methods.description: Adjusts layout for round or square watches.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Updates paint properties based on device features like burn-in protection.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Called every minute in ambient mode; triggers redraw.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts rendering and timers based on ambient mode.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the watch face, including time, date, and optional day of week.

methods.name: updateTimer
methods.description: Starts or stops the time update handler based on current mode.

methods.name: shouldTimerBeRunning
methods.description: Determines if time updates should be active.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to configuration data sent from connected devices.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles establishing data listeners when GoogleApiClient connects.
